item.title: Mississippi National Guard expands winter storm response
item.description: The Mississippi National Guard on Friday activated an additional 150 service members bringing the total to 650 personnel, to conduct general support, fueling operations, and aerial logistics packaging of food, water, medical, and other needed supplies following a major winter storm Jan. 23-26, 2026.

item.title: Mott takes strongman training to world stage
item.description: Local strongman Ryan Mott will make his long-awaited mid-professional level debut when he competes in the 2026 World Strength Games from May 21-23 in St. George, Utah.

item.title: Supervisors hear progress update on Long Creek Dam
item.description: Lauderdale County supervisors on Monday learned more about the current status of a project to repair Long Creek Dam as Waggoner Engineering’s Bill McDonald spoke at a Board of Supervisors Meeting.

item.title: Supervisors hear ambulance proposals as city considers change
item.description: Lauderdale County supervisors on Monday heard proposals from three ambulance providers as county officials consider joining efforts by the city of Meridian to change their emergency medical provider.

item.title: East Mississippi set to open softball season with five scheduled home doubleheaders in February
item.description: With five scheduled home doubleheaders during the month of February, East Mississippi Community College’s 2026 softball season is slated to get started with a home twin bill against Marion Military Institute Tuesday on the Scooba campus.

item.title: City moves forward with Jaycee parking, other projects
item.description: The Meridian City Council voted Tuesday to move forward with several ongoing projects throughout the city after hearing from city officials about the work.

item.title: Deadline extended to Feb. 6 for sophomores to apply for State Board of Education 2026-27 junior rep spot
item.description: Due to inclement weather that impacted much of Mississippi, the application deadline for the Mississippi State Board of Education Junior Student Representative position has been extended to Feb. 6.
